messages:
sam: Heads up - base-image scan flagged multiple crypto CVEs (OpenSSL/glibc) in ubuntu:22.04-slim and alpine:3.18. CVE-2026-2104 looks exploitable. Need patch prioritization and rollout plan.

dev-scan-bot: [automated scan] ubuntu:22.04-slim -> HIGH: OpenSSL CVE-2026-2104, MEDIUM: libssl, glibc CVE-2026-3101

anika: can we confirm which services use these images? I want a list from image inventory.

oscar: quick script to list images using that base:
```
for repo in $(cat repos.txt); do skopeo inspect docker://$repo | jq -r '.RepoTags[]'; done
```

linda: For Dedicated/private customers we need signed images. Adding KMS-backed signature step to pipeline is a blocker for hotfix? If we skip signing temporarily, we must log it and set RBAC so only sec-oncall can push unsigned.

sam: Agreed. Proposal: emergency patch window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC, staging deploy first, smoke-run 30m, then grad rollout to production over 2 hours. Who can approve?

paul: I can approve emergency patch for hosted services. Need checklist: rebuild, scan, sign, record audit entry, update SBOM.

maria: Also check ABI break with glibc bump. Some services link statically? If so, rebuild may not help.

kevin: Suggest list of initial canaries: routing-proxy (low risk), embeddings-worker (cpu heavy), auth-service (critical - test only in staging). Start with proxy.

sam: KMS details: use key 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-sign' and record signature id in build metadata.

anika: RBAC - create short-lived role 'image-rebuilder' limited to CI pipeline trigger; audit logs must include build id, user, commit hash.

oscar: PR for pipeline: https://git.internal/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/4567 - includes signing step and fallback to 'signed=false' with audit tag.

dev-scan-bot: new scan after rebuild: ubuntu:22.04-slim-patched -> no HIGH vulns, MEDIUM: libssl (will be fixed in next minor). :thumbsup:

linda: After rollout, we need KMS key rotation plan and quarterly re-scan cron.

sam: Final action items:
- approve window (paul)
- merge pipeline PR (oscar)
- run staged rebuild tonight (kevin)
- update audit doc (anika)

I'll inform SRE and oncall.

paul: approved. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll kick off when PR merges. Thanks all. :pray:
